title: 5 Best Seafood in Essaouira Port
description: The best seafood in Essaouira port — curated from hundreds of Reddit reviews. Open-air grills, fresh-catch markets, beachfront classics and creative fish burgers. Interactive map included.

places.name: Port Fish Grills (Les Grillades du Port)

comparison.best for: Open-Air Grill in 🍣 Popular Picks — Essaouira, Morocco
comparison.limitations: No major drawbacks called out in the source copy
comparison.why it made the list: This is it. The reason you came to Essaouira. Walk through the port, point at the fish you want, watch a guy grill it over charcoal three feet away, then eat it on a plastic table overlooking the Atlantic with cats circling your ankles. It’s not fine dining — it’s better. Arrive before noon for the freshest catch and less hassle. Skip the stalls closest to the parking lot (tourist prices) and walk deeper into the port area.
comparison.what to order: At Port Fish Grills (Les Grillades du Port), you can enjoy grilled sardines, an Essaouira classic, for 30-50 MAD, along with other fresh seafood. Order a mixed plate of shrimp, calamari, and the freshest fish available, or try freshly shucked oysters right at the port for 5-10 MAD each. Your meal comes with bread, salad, olives, and harissa.

places.name: Le Chalet de la Plage (Chez Jeannot)

comparison.best for: Beachfront Classic in 🍣 Popular Picks — Essaouira, Morocco
comparison.limitations: No major drawbacks called out in the source copy
comparison.why it made the list: The institution. Chez Jeannot has been serving grilled fish on the beach since your grandparents were traveling, and that kind of track record doesn’t happen by accident. It’s not fancy — it’s authentic, and the ocean views are unbeatable. Locals still eat here, which tells you everything. Go for lunch when you want to sit down properly after the morning port chaos.
comparison.what to order: At Le Chalet de la Plage (Chez Jeannot), a beachfront classic, you can expect to pay an unspecified price for highly-rated seafood, as evidenced by its 3.7-star rating from 992 reviews. Order the grilled fresh fish of the day (ask what came in this morning), seafood pastilla, or the classic fish tagine. The grilled sole and sea bream are consistently praised. Pair your meal with Moroccan wine if you're in the mood, as they have a license.

places.name: Essaouira Fish Market (Marché aux Poissons)
places.verdict: Think of it as the “choose your own adventure” version of Essaouira seafood.

comparison.best for: Fish Market & Grill in 🍣 Popular Picks — Essaouira, Morocco
comparison.strengths: 4★ from 1,133 Google reviews · Fish Market & Grill
comparison.limitations: No major drawbacks called out in the source copy
comparison.why it made the list: Think of it as the “choose your own adventure” version of Essaouira seafood. You’re the chef’s buyer, the grill is the stage. More structured and less chaotic than the port grills, with slightly more reliable hygiene. The indoor market gives you shade, better prices than the port entrance stalls, and the thrill of picking your own dinner. Go mid-morning for the best selection.
comparison.what to order: At Essaouira Fish Market (Marché aux Poissons), you can buy and grill your own seafood for an unspecified price, and enjoy a highly-recommended local experience. Pick your own fish from the vendors (sardines, shrimp, sole, sea bream, lobster if you're splashing out), pay to have it cleaned, then hand it to one of the adjacent grill restaurants. Add fries, salad, olives, harissa, and mint tea. The whole experience — buying, cleaning, cooking — is the meal.

places.name: Fish Burger
places.verdict: The new kid that Essaouira didn’t know it needed.

comparison.best for: Modern Street Food in 🍣 Popular Picks — Essaouira, Morocco
comparison.strengths: 4.6★ from 551 Google reviews · Modern Street Food
comparison.limitations: No major drawbacks called out in the source copy
comparison.why it made the list: The new kid that Essaouira didn’t know it needed. A few street tables, a tiny kitchen, and fish burgers that would hold their own in any coastal city. The sardine croquettes alone are worth the walk to the Skala. This is what happens when someone takes Essaouira’s incredible fish and applies a bit of creativity. Affordable, fast, zero pretension. Come for a quick lunch between medina wandering.
comparison.what to order: At Fish Burger, a modern street food vendor, you can enjoy unique seafood burgers for an unspecified price, and see why it has a 4.6-star rating from 551 reviews. Order the sardine patty burger (two perfectly seasoned patties, not dry at all), sardine croquettes (crunchy outside, gooey cheese inside), and deep-fried octopus bits. Everything is made by local women in a tiny kitchen next to the Skala fortification.

comparison.why it made the list: When you’ve had your fill of plastic chairs and charcoal smoke, The Loft is where you go for a proper sit-down dinner. The quirky retro interior is cozy (a bit dark, but that adds to it), and the grilled octopus justifies the price jump from the port grills. No alcohol license, so come for the food, not the wine. Best for a chilly evening when you want comfort and flavor.
comparison.what to order: At The Loft, an upscale Moroccan seafood restaurant, you can expect to pay an unspecified price for elevated seafood dishes, and see why it has a 4.3-star rating from 47 reviews. Order the grilled octopus (the dish everyone raves about), crab salad with avocado mousse, and the prawn and calamari pasta. The seafood here gets a Moroccan-meets-Mediterranean treatment that elevates the local catch without overcomplicating it.
